content: The function EthIf_SetTransceiverWakeupMode shall forward the call to function EthTrcv_SetTransceiverWakeupMode of the corresponding Ethernet Transceiver Driver (EthIfTransceiverIdx) if mode ETHTRCV_WUM_DISABLE has been requested and the current state of the requested Ethernet Transceiver Driver is ETHTRCV_WUM_ENABLE .
